- **Branch:** `devin/p27-5-web-data-layer-wiring`
- **Config:** implement-spec full rigor; `live_verification=false` (pure `web/` change — no hosted spine; D-P27.4-1 stays deferred).

## Deferrals read

`docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` read in full. OPEN rows touching P27: **D-P27-SPEC-1** (ADR-090 §39–41
SIG-UI dossier-index id owed to P27.6 — NOT this ticket), **D-P27.1-1** (OSM-land re-audit — not
unblocked here), **D-P27.4-1** (live `--from-spine` over hosted spine — no proxy/creds/egress here;
stays OPEN). None of these are unblocked by P27.5. This ticket opens **D-P27.5-1** (below): the
export pipeline does not yet emit the map density-bins / network centrality analytics or the
editorial/methodology constants, so the data seam serves them as committed constants in both modes.

## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Extend `web/src/lib/data.ts` (ADR-066) with typed getters mirroring the P27.1 contracts —
   `getMapSites`, `getNetwork`, `getFreshness`, `getCoverage`, `getWatch`, `getEvidence`,
   `getCorrections`, `getResearchQueue`, `getDossierIndex` — each `fixtures | export`
   (`<exportDir>/web/<artifact>.json` from P27.4), failing LOUD in export mode on a missing artifact.
2. Repoint every listed page (`map`, `network`, `reference-map`, `reference-graph`, `data-freshness`,
   `coverage-metrics`, `watch`, `evidence/*`, `corrections`, `research-queue`, `dossier/*`) off direct
   `*-fixture.ts` imports onto the data layer; a grep shows no page importing a `*-fixture.ts` directly.
3. Build-time pagination/summarisation so national-scale surfaces (210 sources; tens of thousands of
   map sites) stay within the a11y/perf budget (minimal here; detailed tables land in P27.7).
4. Both modes green (`npm --prefix web run check` in fixtures and export).
5. Records: this run ledger + PR body.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] every public page reads through `data.ts`; grep shows no page importing a `*-fixture.ts`.
- [ ] `SIG_DATA_SOURCE=export` renders real export bytes on all surfaces; a missing artifact fails loud.
- [ ] `npm --prefix web run check` passes in BOTH modes (typecheck, unit, build, licenses, e2e incl. axe).
- [ ] zero-JS budget holds (script bytes 0, ≤150 KB); large surfaces paginate/summarise at build time.
- [ ] `make check` + build-memory green.

## Plan

- data.ts: nine surface getters (fixtures constant | parse `<exportDir>/web/<artifact>.json`, fail loud
  on missing/invalid — mirrors the existing `getDossiers`/`getLeverageMetric` pattern). Plus a section of
  auxiliary accessors returning committed presentation constants (density bins, centrality, decision
  point, capture diff, provenance summaries, jurisdiction claims, editorial constants, and the
  reference-page exemplars) so no page imports a fixture directly. A `capRows` build-time
  pagination/summarisation helper for national-scale tables.
- Pages: swap every `*-fixture.ts` import for the data-layer getters; behaviour byte-identical in
  fixtures mode (no rendering change) so the existing e2e/a11y suite is unaffected.
- Verification harness (pure web): `web/scripts/build-fixture-export.ts` serialises the committed
  fixtures into the P27.1 export layout (`<dir>/web/*.json` + dossiers/leverage + tiles), so export mode
  is exercised against real on-disk bytes with fixture-equivalent content (the P21.4 precedent). Run via
  the bundled `esbuild`.

- Harness: `web/scripts/build-fixture-export.ts` + `npm run export:fixtures`.
- Composed-stack S8 export-build fixture updated to overlay the ten surface JSONs (test-only).

## Evidence log

- `npm --prefix web run check` **fixtures**: typecheck 0 errors; **183** unit passed; build 50 pages;
  licenses "All 198 production dependencies OSI"; e2e **192 passed** (chromium + no-js, axe WCAG 2.2 AA).
- `npm --prefix web run check` **export** (`SIG_DATA_SOURCE=export SIG_EXPORT_DIR=<fixture-export bundle>`):
  typecheck 0 errors; **183** unit passed; build 50 pages; e2e **192 passed**.
- Fail-loud: `SIG_DATA_SOURCE=export SIG_EXPORT_DIR=<bundle-without-watch.json> npm run build` → **exit 1**,
  "SIG_DATA_SOURCE=export but the export artifact is missing: …/web/watch.json".
- Zero-JS: `grep -rl "<script" dist --include=*.html | grep -v /curate/` → **none**; largest public
  HTML 26.9 KB (≤150 KB).
- `make check` → **exit 0**, 3552 passed / 3 skipped / 0 failed; `verify-gen` clean (no ontology/pylock churn).
- e2e note: this environment's `astro preview` detaches as a daemon, so playwright's managed webServer
  reports an early exit; e2e was run against a pre-started `astro preview` (reuseExistingServer=true) —
  all 192 tests pass in both modes.
